A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UniWM research and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. The complete material supports reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original navigation and visual-prediction experiments, ablations, generalization results, and inference-time comparisons in Tables 1–8 and A1 and associated figures.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark evaluations, ablations, humanoid-navigation experiments, and appendix comparisons.

M1.justification: The backbone, training losses, action representation, hierarchical memory, and inference algorithm are unchanged. The corrected layer-subset notation in Section 3.3 agrees with the five-layer selection already specified in v2's implementation details and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use Go Stanford, ReCon, SCAND, and HuRoN for robot navigation, TartanDrive for unseen evaluation, and the 1X Humanoid navigation subset with 25-DoF actions. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding navigation comparisons retain GNM, VINT, NoMaD, Anole-7B, and NWM; visualization comparisons retain Diamond, Aether, and NWM. The expanded description of NWM's CEM optimization does not establish a changed evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Appendix B.1 withdraws the explicit image-text cosine calculation previously specified for DreamSim in Eq. A1, retaining the frame-comparison description and cited metric. This changes the documented metric specification without establishing that evaluation was rerun. Splits, sample counts, training settings, metric names, and rollout procedures otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The seven ablation questions in Section 4.3, TartanDrive failure analysis, inference-time comparison, and supplementary qualitative examples are retained. Moving the Appendix B.2–B.3 text does not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or error bars. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Figure 1 changes NoMaD's HuRoN SR/ATE/RPE from 0.27/1.16/0.41 to 0.37/0.92/0.33, matching Table 1 in both versions. Tables 1–8 and A1 and the remaining result displays are unchanged; this is a figure correction, not a new UniWM performance gain.

T1.justification: v3 removes the explicit mathematical definition of DreamSim as image-text cosine similarity in Appendix Eq. A1 without replacing it. The main model equations and Algorithm 1 remain; the layer-set notation is clarified to match the previously specified subset selection.

C1.justification: The unification, memory, performance, zero-shot transfer, and 25-DoF extension claims are retained. Changing 'humanoid control' to 'humanoid navigation' aligns terminology with the navigation-only extension already explicitly described in v2.

C2.justification: Section 3.1 newly specifies misalignment as a discrepancy between the planner's implicit state assumption and the world model's predicted state. Section 2 explains why NWM remains loosely coupled despite CEM scoring complete trajectories. Existing domain-gap and token-budget limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: The code/model repository pointer changes from F1y1113/UniWM to UWMILab/UniWM. Appendix B.1 removes detailed perceptual-metric explanations, while hyperparameters, hardware, prompt examples, and inference-time information are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds citations to ActWorld, UniDrive-WM, Driver-WM, Agentic World Modeling, and Language-conditioned World Modeling for Visual Navigation. The finance-agent survey reference is removed, and the comparison with NWM is refined to discuss CEM trajectory optimization. The central research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: Localized edits clarify terminology, correct pseudocode line references, update author and acknowledgment text, shorten Appendix B.1, and add Appendix C's LLM-use disclosure. The main narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives small changes to panel geometry, spacing, and label formatting. Other figures and tables are retained, with limited appendix and bibliography reflow; no new result visualization is introduced.

improvement.justification: v3 improves internal consistency by correcting Figure 1 to match Table 1, clarifying memory-layer selection, and fixing algorithm cross-references. Removing the image-text DreamSim formula resolves a conflict with the stated frame-comparison protocol, although no replacement detailed calculation is supplied. These corrections and clearer explanations provide a limited net improvement; the method and empirical support remain essentially unchanged.
